subject: RE: Quick demo — vendor intake and security checklist
messages:
From: Sandy Park <sandy.park@novexhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@novexhealth.com
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo — vendor intake is blocking us

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the time earlier this week. We were excited to get the technical demo scheduled for Tue, Apr 28, but procurement pulled our demo team into a vendor intake step this morning. Two items are blocking us right now:

- Our vendor portal requires an executed NDA and a filled security questionnaire before we can share execs' calendar slots.
- They want a short list of evidence artifacts (SOC2 summary, data retention policy) uploaded to the portal request (ID 1523).

I checked with Legal and Procurement — they expect this to be completed by early next week, but we can't guarantee the Apr 28 slot. Can we pause/hold the demo and aim for a follow-up window after May 3?

If it helps, I can share screenshots from the portal and the specific questionnaire fields. Apologies for the disruption — procurement has tightened controls for this program.

Thanks,
Sandy Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Novex Health
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sandy Park <sandy.park@novexhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick demo — vendor intake is blocking us

Hi Sandy —

Totally understand, and thanks for the heads up. We can put the Apr 28 demo on hold and target the week of May 4–8. Two quick asks so we can use the extra time productively:

1) Can you upload the portal screenshot(s) and the questionnaire PDF (or a link) to the ticket? That will let our security team pre-populate answers and prepare the SOC/retention artifacts.
2) Would Novex be open to a 20–30 minute pre-demo technical sync with one of our engineers while procurement completes onboarding? We can use that call to validate sample prompts and confirm network requirements (IP allowlist, SSO).

I attached our SOW template and a short checklist that maps common portal questionnaire fields to Redwood artifacts — should speed review.

Suggested next steps:
- You: confirm whether NDA is signed or if we should circulate an executed copy (we can attach a stub).
- Us: schedule a short technical readiness call (20–30m) for next week if you have a contact on the technical side.

If you prefer, I can coordinate with our onboarding specialist to submit the artifacts directly to the portal once you tell us which fields to fill.

Soojín Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0143
Attachment: redwood_sow_template.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Novex — procurement intake (they asked to pause demo)

Folks — forwarding Novex's note. They pushed the demo because procurement requires NDA + questionnaire answers uploaded to their vendor portal (ticket 1523). Can we fast-track the following items?

- Rafael: can you pull the SOC2 summary and a short retention blurb we can upload immediately?
- Priyom: they often want billing/commit details on the vendor form — can you provide a short answers doc ("pricing model: usage-based; PO accepted; contact for invoices")?
- Monica: any legal redlines we should watch for if they ask for an executed NDA? We can supply our standard mutual NDA (I have a signed stub as a placeholder).

If we can get artifacts into the portal by Monday morning (Apr 27), we should be able to keep a May 5–7 demo window instead of delaying further. I can own the outreach to Novex to coordinate uploads.

Thanks —
Soojín

Hi Sandy —

Thanks for the quick update and for offering portal screenshots. We uploaded a short packet to the Drive link for Novex (links below) and attached a signed NDA stub to this reply to speed procurement review. Rafael and Priyom will also populate the portal fields if you confirm which specific form entries they want filled.

Proposed demo plan:
- Hold Apr 28 slot; target live demo week of May 4–8.
- Tentative technical readiness call (20m) on Thu, Apr 29 if Novex can free a technical contact — helps identify any SSO/IP requirements.
- We will update ticket 1523 with SOC2 summary + retention note + billing phrasing by EOD Apr 26.

Attachments included: signed_nda_stub.pdf, redwood_sow_template.pdf. I also attached a screenshot (novex_vendor_portal_screenshot.png) of the fields we saw — please confirm which boxes need to be populated.

If you want me to submit the artifacts on your behalf into the portal, grant us a portal contact or a one-time upload token and we'll take care of the rest.

Look forward to getting this over the finish line — apologize again for the back-and-forth.

Best,
Soojín Lee
